Who we are

Lightricks is reimagining the way creators express themselves. We use innovative technology and fine-tuned design to reshape the creator experience. Our suite of tools and services, including Facetune, Videoleap, Photoleap, and Popular Pays, have changed the way millions of people create. Join us and take part in building the future of content creation.

Our values

Create fun

We’re all about creation, passion, and keeping the workplace playful.

Embrace change

The creative process is fluid and always reflects transformation.

Get things done

We look beyond the task and turn thoughts into actions.

Invest in people

Because we know that it’s our people who make us who we are.

Strong opinions, loosely held

We speak up and listen because we know great ideas can come from anyone.

Our culture: Work hard & have fun

We offer a vibrant workplace that is fulfilling and rewarding, where employees know they can make an impact. We invest in our people by offering them learning opportunities and room for collaboration, ideas that are both essential to our DNA.

Our locations: Creation is everywhere

We have a number of international offices with each location focusing on certain teams and specialties. Join us in one of our global locations: Jerusalem, Haifa, London, Shenzhen, and across the United States as we support creators throughout their journey.

Our mission: Bring ideas to life

Everyone should experience the magic of bringing their ideas to life. That’s why we push the limits of technology to make products and services that give creators new ways to explore their curiosity.

Ready to join us?
